test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Despite their differences, the counties found common ground and __buried the hatchet__.

options.text: To seek revenge in the future

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to bury the hatchet"** means to settle a dispute or conflict and become reconciled. (मतभेदों को समाप्त करना और मेल-मिलाप करना)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of rivalry, the two companies decided to bury the hatchet and collaborate on a new project.
 
 
 
• **"To continue a conflict"** means to keep on fighting or disagreeing. (संघर्ष जारी रखना)
 
 
• **Example: **The two neighbors continued their conflict over the property line for years.
 
 
 
• **"To disagree publicly"** means to show disagreement openly. (सार्वजनिक रूप से असहमति व्यक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The politicians disagreed publicly on the new policy.
 
 
 
• **"To seek revenge in the future"** means to plan to get back at someone later. (भविष्य में बदला लेने की योजना बनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He pretended to forgive his rival but planned to seek revenge in the future.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To continue a conflict** (संघर्ष जारी रखना): To keep on fighting or disagreeing.

 
 
• **Example:** The two neighbors continued their conflict over the property line for years.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To disagree publicly** (सार्वजनिक रूप से असहमति व्यक्त करना): To show disagreement openly.
 
 
• **Example:** The politicians disagreed publicly on the new policy.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To seek revenge in the future** (भविष्य में बदला लेने की योजना बनाना): To plan to get back at someone later.
 
 
• **Example:** He pretended to forgive his rival but planned to seek revenge in the future.
